Estimate dropout between two doses

Source: R/estimate.R
estimate_dropout.Rd

Dropout can be defined in two ways, and the two do not give the same answer:

estimate_dropout(
  design,
  first,
  last,
  by = NULL,
  method = c("individual", "coverage"),
  evidence = "card_or_recall",
  prefix = "cov_",
  level = 0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

Arguments

design

A vcs_design() or vcs_data object.

first, last

Vaccine names bracketing the series, e.g. "PENTA1" and "PENTA3".

by

Domains.

method

"individual" (default) or "coverage".

evidence

Definition of vaccination used when the indicator must be derived.

prefix

Prefix of the coverage columns.

level

Confidence level.

na.rm

Exclude children of unknown status.

Value

A vcs_estimate tibble. The method column records which definition produced each row.

Details

  • method = "coverage" – the classic programme indicator, (coverage(first) - coverage(last)) / coverage(first), computed from the two survey-weighted coverage estimates. Its confidence interval is obtained by the delta method over the joint design-based covariance.

  • method = "individual" – the proportion of children who received first but not last, estimated directly from individual vaccination histories with derive_dropout().

The individual method is the more defensible of the two because it uses each child's own history rather than two marginal estimates, but the coverage method is what most programme reports quote. Always state which was used.

See also

derive_dropout(), estimate_coverage()

Examples

d <- derive_vaccination_status(vcs_example)
des <- vcs_design(d)

estimate_dropout(des, first = "PENTA1", last = "PENTA3")
#> <vcs_estimate: 1 row(s)>
#> # A tibble: 1 × 14
#>   indicator      domain numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low conf_high
#>   <chr>          <chr>      <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 PENTA1-PENTA3… <over…        94         226    0.415 0.0291    0.358     0.472
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: n_unweighted <dbl>, deff <dbl>, neff <dbl>, icc <dbl>,
#> #   ci_method <chr>, method <chr>
estimate_dropout(des, first = "PENTA1", last = "PENTA3", by = ~stratum)
#> <vcs_estimate: 2 row(s)>
#> # A tibble: 2 × 15
#>   indicator        domain stratum numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low
#>   <chr>            <chr>  <chr>       <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 PENTA1-PENTA3 d… rural  rural          57         107    0.530 0.0341    0.463
#> 2 PENTA1-PENTA3 d… urban  urban          37         119    0.310 0.0412    0.229
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: conf_high <dbl>, n_unweighted <dbl>, deff <dbl>,
#> #   neff <dbl>, icc <dbl>, ci_method <chr>, method <chr>
estimate_dropout(des, first = "BCG", last = "MCV1", method = "coverage")
#> <vcs_estimate: 1 row(s)>
#> # A tibble: 1 × 11
#>   domain   numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low conf_high n_unweighted
#>   <chr>        <int>       <int>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>        <int>
#> 1 <overal…        67         218    0.287 0.0390    0.210     0.363          253
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: deff <dbl>, indicator <chr>, method <chr>
